CROSS-REFERENCE — provenance. This removal came out of the 2026-08-12 deprecation removal-readiness survey, originally written up on childsafe-bizarre-lorikeet (comment 11) — a scratchpad placement the operator has since ruled an anti-pattern. Survey summary now in session log cosey-vinegarish-mouflon (d0d8-9dfe-f2d8-4364), entry 2.

What the survey said about this item: REBAR_LLM_MODEL / llm.model (_deprecations.py:101, deprecated 1fbfb5c691 2026-08-01, shipped in v0.11.0) is a SUPERSESSION rather than a rename — the [tool.rebar.llm.model_classes] slots landed 2026-07-31 (4559258b98), and the parent story eb58 (fiendish-communal-cuttlefish) recorded "DEPRECATED with a migration window rather than kept as a permanent alias", remove_in=v1.0.0, with the window stated in docs/env-vars.md:66 and docs/config.md:317. Size SMALL (one registry row plus the alias resolver in config.py, llm/config.py, llm/model_classes.py), risk LOW. Rated NOT YET on schedule and named the second candidate for a third pre-1.0 breaking window at v0.12.0 — carried together with priceless-charred-fruitbat, since both are v1.0.0-scheduled supersessions that would then satisfy the one-minor-release floor in docs/api-stability.md:30.
